en: The relation between potential and act, not-now and ‘now’, non-actuality and presence, has an amphibious character. It participates
becoming, and, at the same time, also constitutes the cornerstone and framework
becoming itself. It is inscribed
chronological
, but on the other hand determines the temporal

from which this progression originates. Such a relation seems to forbid any attempt to draw a solid boundary between the temporalised phenomena and the fundamental structures of temporality, the empirical appearance and the hidden recesses. From the outset, the potential/act couple is established above and beyond any such boundary, displaying a marked inclination towards playing a double game.
zh: 潜能与实现、非现在与‘现在’、非现实性与在场之间的关系，具有两栖性质。它参与生成，同时又构成生成本身的基石和框架。它被铭写在年代推进中，另一方面却又规定了这种推进所由产生的时间秩序。这种关系似乎禁止我们在时间化的现象与时间性的根本结构、经验显象与隐蔽深处之间划出一道牢固边界。潜能／实现这一对概念从一开始就在任何此类边界之上和之外确立，并显示出明显的双重游戏倾向。

en: It is necessary briefly to demonstrate this inherent ambivalence. Within chronological progression, potential and act are
; vice versa, in terms of the temporal order, the two terms are positioned as a
and

, the faculty being the indefinite past of the execution. So concomitance, but also diachrony; diachrony, but also concomitance. Kant imputed the responsibility for this double requisite to the causal nexus (remember the example of the stove and the heated room), whereas in fact it pertains only to potential’s relation with the act. But to recognise this is far from exhausting the matter. What is really at issue, here, is to grasp the intersection or chiasm between concomitance and diachrony.
zh: 有必要简要说明这种内在的双重性。在年代推进之内，潜能与实现同时存在；反过来，就时间秩序而言，两项则被安置成先与后，官能是实行的不确定过去。因此，既有同时，又有历时；既有历时，又有同时。康德把这一双重要求归于因果联系——回想火炉和被加热房间的例子——而事实上，它只属于潜能同实现的关系。但认识到这一点远未穷尽问题。这里真正要把握的，是同时与历时之间的交叉或交错结构（chiasm）。

en: The potential not-now and the actual ‘now’ do not cease to
time into before and after, even when they are progressing
time simultaneously; nor does the fact that they order it by way of their essential discrepancy

mean that they are not progressing in time in unison. A before and an after thus share the same date; conversely, it is a pair of simultaneous elements that articulate the ‘before’ and the ‘after’. The object, or field of application, of concomitance, is a diachrony: the
. In turn, the diachrony appears within a concomitance: the

. As far as the potential/act dyad is concerned, it is misleading to go on speaking about a simple chronological progression or an inconspicuous temporal order, when what instead always prevails is a middle zone in which these ambits achieve hybrid form – or rather, in which each entails the other. If we place the accent on the concomitance of the diachronous, then we ought to speak of the

zh: 潜在的非现在与现实的‘现在’，即使在时间中同步推进，也从未停止把时间排列为先与后；同样，它们凭借本质差异来排列时间，也并不意味着它们没有齐头并进。于是，一个‘先’与一个‘后’分享同一日期；反过来，正是一对同时存在的要素，把‘先’与‘后’分节出来。同时性的对象或作用领域，是一种历时性：历时之物的同时性。反过来，历时性又显现在同时之中：同时之物的历时性。就潜能／实现这一对而言，继续谈论单纯的年代推进或不显眼的时间秩序会造成误导；真正始终占主导地位的，是一个中间地带，两个领域在这里获得混合形态——更确切地说，各自都蕴含另一个。如果重音落在历时之物的同时性上，我们就应当谈论也在进行排序之物的推进；如果强调同时之物的历时性，我们就应当突出也在推进之物所建立的秩序。

en: This type of magnetic storm, which stirs up and mixes together hitherto carefully separated points of view, is all the more important for that very reason. It highlights the obstacles faced by any attempt to illustrate the link between potential and act through categories (temporal order, chronological progression) that in fact

. Potential, the enduring not-now, represents time as a whole; the act, the evanescent ‘now’, indicates a determinate position in the calendar. And time-as-a-whole (potential) and the thing present within time (act) are not even conceivable outside of the bind that connects them. It is this
which is originary – that sustains these two correlates as different and indeed incommensurable poles. The distinction between the totality of time and temporalised reality depends on (and originates
from) their preliminary intersection. Only presupposing this intersection –
the potential/act binary – is it legitimate to speak of either an ‘order
time’ or ‘progression
time’. We ought not be surprised, then, that when these categories are called upon to give account of their

(the potential/act binary), they blend into one another, are mixed up in an inextricable tangle, and again tend towards indistinction. The formation of a middle zone, or no-man’s-land, between two planes that we previously deemed inassimilable, reveals, even if obliquely and
, that they have one and the same root.
zh: 正因为如此，这种搅动并混合此前被谨慎分开的视角的磁暴才格外重要。它突出显示了这样一种尝试所遭遇的障碍：用实际上已经预设潜能与实现关系的范畴——时间秩序、年代推进——来说明这种关系。潜能，即持续的非现在，代表作为整体的时间；实现，即转瞬即逝的‘现在’，标示历法中的一个确定位置。而作为整体的时间（潜能）与时间之内的在场之物（实现），脱离二者之间的联系，便根本不可设想。正是这一原初关系，把两个相关项维系成彼此不同、实际上不可通约的两极。时间总体与时间化现实之间的区别，依赖于并发源于二者先在的交叉。只有预设了这个交叉——也就是潜能／实现二元——谈论‘时间秩序’或‘在时间中推进’才是正当的。因此，当这些范畴被要求说明自身共同基础——潜能／实现二元——时，它们相互交融，混杂成无法解开的纠结，再次趋向无差别，我们不应感到惊讶。两个先前被认为无法同化的平面之间形成中间地带或无人区，这便以迂回且事后的方式揭示：二者具有同一个根。

en: What have we learnt from this brief look at the temporal status of act and potential? We must now cast aside all those unilateral formulations that, in isolating one particular perspective, stand outside of our magnetic storm. The amphibious or ambivalent character of the dyad in question coincides with its most

mode of existence. It counts not in the last analysis, but in the first. For the purposes of expressing this character, it must, naturally, be situated within the no-man’s-land in which the distinction between ‘order’ and ‘progression’ is blurred and becomes uncertain. As we know, here it is the
(or – but it is the same thing – the diachrony of the concomitant) that predominates. In compliance with this predominance, we must say that

children: potential and act are an always-simultaneous ‘before’ and ‘after’;

en: the not-now precedes the ‘now’ with which it also coexists; the pure past, captured in the language faculty, is contemporary to the empirical present which is on each occasion articulated by the really-uttered word. Such are the
thus they cannot be further broken down
– propositions suggested by this belated glance at the temporal status of act and potential.
zh: 从这次对实现与潜能之时间地位的简要考察中，我们学到了什么？现在必须抛开所有孤立某一特定视角、因而置身于这场磁暴之外的单方面表述。所论二元组的两栖性或双重性，同它最直接的存在方式相重合。它不是归根结底才重要，而是一开始就重要。为了表达这种性质，自然必须把它安置在‘秩序’与‘推进’的区别变得模糊而不确定的无人区。我们知道，这里占主导地位的是历时之物的同时性——或者，同时之物的历时性；二者是一回事。依照这种主导地位，我们必须说，潜能与实现是一对永远同时存在的‘先’与‘后’；非现在先于同它共存的‘现在’；语言官能所承载的纯粹过去，与每次由实际说出的词所分节的经验当下同时存在。这些就是这次姗姗来迟地考察实现与潜能之时间地位所提出的基本命题——而所谓基本，意味着它们无法进一步分解。

en: We would understand little about the potential/act couple if we did not examine them in terms of time. An example: the two terms’ radical

(of nature, not degree) is apparent only if they are understood as a past and a present. Moreover, it is not difficult to see that this same couple itself alters and deepens our understanding of time in general. Example: when they assume the features of potential and act, the past and the present no longer designate successive moments, but concomitant dimensions. The temporal concepts (not-now, now, simultaneity, diachrony, etc.) used to analyse the relation between faculty and execution do not come out of the analysis unchanged. The peculiar object to which they are applied deforms and complicates them, altering their basic meaning. The past represented by the capacity-to-speak or labour-power is something other than the ordinary past represented by a repository of already-spoken words and already-accomplished labours. The relation between faculty and execution, which required explanation, thus from a certain point onward itself becomes the true explanatory key. This circular movement (the
which retroactively acts upon the

) is, perhaps, the distinctive trait of a materialist approach to the question of temporality. Or, at least, of an approach that renounces surreptitiously drawing on the resources provided by theology. We can only consider time with the aid of a phenomenon which it has itself allowed us to consider; on condition, understand, that this phenomenon can in exchange provoke a drastic
consideration of the temporal notions initially mobilised in its own regard.
zh: 如果不从时间角度考察潜能／实现这一对，我们对它们几乎不会有什么理解。举例说，只有把两项理解为过去与当下，它们之间根本性的差异——性质差异而非程度差异——才会显现。此外不难看出，这一概念对本身也会改变并深化我们对一般时间的理解。例如，过去与当下呈现潜能和实现的特征时，便不再指称相继的时刻，而指称同时的维度。用来分析官能与实行关系的时间概念——非现在、现在、同时性、历时性等等——并未原封不动地走出这场分析。它们所应用的特殊对象使它们变形和复杂化，改变了它们的基本含义。言说能力或劳动力所代表的过去，不同于已经说出的词与已经完成的劳动所构成的储存库所代表的普通过去。这样，从某一点开始，原本需要解释的官能与实行关系，自身反而成为真正的解释钥匙。这种循环运动——被解释项（explicandum）反过来作用于解释项（explicans）——或许正是唯物主义处理时间性问题的独特标志；至少，它标志着一种拒绝暗中调用神学资源的进路。我们只能借助一个由时间本身使我们能够考察的现象来思考时间；当然，条件是这个现象反过来能够促使我们彻底重新审视起初为考察它而调动的时间概念。

en: If we develop our interpretation of the potential/act couple on the basis of time, pushing onward with a certain tenacity, then we will ultimately – almost inadvertently – find ourselves interpreting time on the basis of the potential/act couple. A
inquiry into the modalities of the possible and the real on each occasion turns into a

inquiry into temporality. The diversion – or better, change of purpose – is inevitable. This has arisen again and again over the previous pages; indeed, with difficulty would we point out anywhere that it is entirely absent. Here, however, this diversion must be made explicit and expounded in full. It is now necessary to clarify in what manner the coexistence of potential and act, not-now and ‘now’, past in general and determinate present, is
’s supporting structure and condition of possibility.
zh: 如果我们从时间出发阐释潜能／实现这一对，并以某种执着把这种阐释推进下去，那么最终——几乎不经意间——我们会发现，自己正在从潜能／实现这一对出发阐释时间。每一次，对可能与实在这两种模态的时间研究，都会转变成对时间性的模态研究。这一绕行——更准确地说，目的转换——不可避免。在此前各页中，它一再发生；我们甚至很难指出哪里完全没有这种转换。不过在这里，必须把这次转向明确提出并充分展开。现在需要澄清：潜能与实现、非现在与‘现在’、一般过去与确定当下的共存，以何种方式构成历史时间的支撑结构与可能性条件。
